description: The architecture forger is built on: pure decisions, I/O at the edges, and the dependency rule enforced by check arch.

opinions.summary: Decisions are pure functions; I/O lives at the edges.
Every external system sits behind an interface with one adapter and a fake for tests.
The core never imports the shell; the layer map in .claude/architecture.json says which layer may import which.
Outside input is parsed once at the boundary into types.
An unreadable source is an error, never an empty result.
Commands are idempotent and print machine-readable output.
Each fact has one source; derived values are computed, not stored.
Per-project variation lives in config, and the config is schema-checked.
A shared shape changes by expanding, migrating its users, then contracting.
A small interface over a lot of behaviour.
